description: Weekly X Champion belt lineage — the league's signature mechanic. Week 1 crowns the highest-scoring team; every week after, the holder forces one FLEX-eligible player into their opponent's starting lineup (sabotage), declared in league chat by Friday 11:59 PM CT. The belt transfers to whoever beats the holder. Nothing else — not Sleeper, not Flaim — tracks this, which is why this file exists.

weeks.notes: Official chat drop 2026-09-15: THE FIRST ❌ CHAMP IS CROWNED: @Nels8951. Week 1 league-high 189.8 PPR (beat Maxwellhiggens 189.8–129.3). Runner-up anyfoolwilldo 189.5. Week 2 opponent: trappat. Lock due Friday 11:59 PM CT.
